'''Angelina Cabras''' (23 December 1898 – 19 June 1993) was an Italian [[mathematician]] and [[physicist]]. She earned degrees in mathematics from the [[University of Turin]] in 1924 and in physics from the [[University of Cagliari]] in 1927. She obtained a position in [[mathematical physics]] at Cagliari, later moving to the institute of [[theoretical mechanics]] there. Her research concerned higher dimensional [[rigid body dynamics]], the [[theory of relativity]], and [[inductance]].<ref>{{citation|url=http://matematica-old.unibocconi.it/storia/letterac/cabras.htm|title=Cabras Angelina|work=Biografie di matematici italiani|publisher=PRISTEM, [[Bocconi University]]|accessdate=2016-07-07|language=Italian|archive-date=2016-08-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160811092830/http://matematica-old.unibocconi.it/storia/letterac/cabras.htm|url-status=dead}}.</ref><ref>{{citation|url=http://docplayer.it/14662282-Gender-mainstreaning-nella-storia-della-matematica.html|title=Gender mainstreaming nella storia della matematica|first1=Maria Antonietta|last1=De Martinis|first2=Lucia|last2=Maddalena|publisher=Dipartimento di Scienze Economiche, Matematiche e Statistiche, Università degli Studi di Foggia|date=2008|accessdate=2016-07-07}}.</ref>

She was an [[list of International Congresses of Mathematicians Plenary and Invited Speakers|invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 1928.<ref>{{citation|url=http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers since 1897|publisher=[[International Mathematical Union]]|accessdate=2016-07-07|archive-date=2017-11-24|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171124141541/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByLastname.php|url-status=dead}}.</ref><ref>{{citation|contribution-url=http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1928.5/Main/icm1928.5.0113.0118.ocr.pdf|first=Angelina|last=Cabras|title=Proc. ICM|year=1928|contribution=Fenomeni transitori in un ponte di Wheatstone a constituzione complessa}}.</ref>

She died in [[Cagliari]] in 1993.<ref name=archiviostorico>{{cite web | title=Archivo Storico (Università degli Studi di Cagliari): Cabras Cusino Angelina|url=https://archiviostorico.unica.it/persone/cabras-cusino-angelina| access-date=2021-04-11}}</ref>
